messages:
Ashley: PTAL — I addressed the comments on PR #4827. Renamed the ConfigMap key from `traffic_weights` -> `infra/trafficWeights` and updated the rollout handler to read both legacy and new keys. Added a smoke e2e that flips weights locally and a short changelog entry. Notes in the PR and the commit message. Need two eyes for canary scheduling; this is a small behavioral change in traffic split. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4827 :eyes:

Mike: quick skim — lgtm from codegen/runtime side. One nit: in rollout.go around the handler init (line ~142) there's a TODO that should either link to the issue or be removed. Also suggest keeping a one-release alias for the old key to avoid sudden breakage.

Sanjay: i'll run the smoke in staging now. if it passes, can we book the canary today? i'm free after 17:00 PT.

Priyaa: PTAL in a bit — can do a final pass at ~10:30 PT. agree with Mike re: alias. small comment on docstring wording but not blocking.

ops-bot: Canary slot reserved for this PR: 2025-06-12T18:00:00Z (canary-queue). I will auto-notify ops and post a follow-up when merged.

Mike: left an inline suggestion to preserve the old key as a deprecated alias for one release cycle, plus a tiny nudge to update the migration note. :thumbsup:

Ashley: Thanks — re-added the alias and the migration note, pushed branch `fix/alias-deprecate`. @Mike can you recheck the inline? @Sanjay please ping here when your smoke run completes.

Sanjay: smoke finished, all checks green. quick tail of the logs: `ok 12/12 checks` — no regressions observed in routing and no tokenization errors. Standing by for merge.

Priyaa: LGTM — the docstring nit is fixed. prefer to merge after the booked slot so we can monitor traffic, but if we need faster, i'm fine either way.

Ashley: sounds good. Merging into canary at the ops-bot slot unless anyone objects. I'll open a follow-up to remove the alias in the next minor release and add a regression test. :shipit:
